responsibility: Defines the crate’s public transmutability API and shared result vocabulary. This root file exposes the layout analysis module, keeps the transmutability decision engine internal, and declares the core assumption flags (`Assume`) plus the stable answer/condition/reason enums used to report whether one type may be transmuted into another and under what requirements or failure causes. When built with rustc integration enabled, it also provides the compiler-facing bridge types and entry points that translate rustc type information and const transmute options into queries answered by the internal `maybe_transmutable` analysis.
